$comment: A one-time code from the owner's phone to their desktops (T-0135). The phone sends a
device_event `otp_received` (android-app RoutineWatcher.relayCode) only over a live socket;
jarvis-core (devices.ConnectedDevices.relay_code) checks it, drops a repeat, and pushes
`show_code` to every connected desktop; the desktop (aura_desktop/codepopup.py) shows the
popup and, after a copy or a dismiss on one desktop, sends `code_done`, which the house
turns into `show_code_dismiss` for the others. The code is never put on the event bus,
logged, queued or stored: a desktop that is offline when it arrives never sees it.
Only a phone (platform android) may raise a code and only a desktop end one; `from` is
the text's sender as the phone has it, which a stranger can set: it is marked untrusted.
The phone sends codes only after the owner said yes once ("codes.relay" prompt).
